detector_defect_found_and_fixed.symptom: ValueError: path is on mount '\\.\NUL', start on mount 'C:'
detector_defect_found_and_fixed.cause: os.path.relpath() on a file literally named NUL - Windows resolves the reserved stem to a device, so the file has no drive mount. The FIRST version of this enumerator CRASHED and produced zero counts.
detector_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: relpath computed by prefix-stripping the DIRECTORY (a normal path) + filename; size/read via the \\?\ extended-length prefix
detector_defect_found_and_fixed.note: This is the briefed Windows-reserved-device-name class, hit for real. Had the crash been swallowed, every count in this file would have been 0 and would have read as 'trees are empty'.

test_baseline.DISCLOSED_DEVIATION_FROM_CI: CI runs each suite with the venv `pytest` CONSOLE SCRIPT after `pip install -e`. This runner used `python -m pytest` and performed NO installs (installing would mutate the shared interpreter). `-m pytest` prepends CWD to sys.path, so it is a BROKEN DETECTOR for packaging/import-path regressions. It measures TEST OUTCOMES only, NOT CI's packaging gate.

Those are NOT-CHECKED, not passing.

failures_triaged.error_verbatim: REACH-6 -: register snapshot sha256 1a404a91d819 != recorded 8b3e44cc3813 / FAILED:cc-validate violations=1
failures_triaged.root_cause: WINDOWS CRLF ARTIFACT - NOT a CI failure and NOT a real regression.
failures_triaged.proof: git cat-file -p HEAD:command-center/sources/REGISTER.md -> 56931 bytes, 0 CRLF, sha256 8b3e44cc3813b46c5c1458dffa1a7cae0a05d04fbcce2afd341adc67b293f9ae == the recorded provenance.register_sha256 EXACTLY. The working-tree copy is 57235 bytes with 304 CRLF pairs, sha256 1a404a91d819... 57235-56931 = 304 = the CRLF count, so the delta is pure EOL expansion.
failures_triaged.why_it_happens: core.autocrlf=true and .gitattributes has no `*.md eol=lf` rule (`git check-attr text eol -- command-center/sources/REGISTER.md` -> both 'unspecified'), so every .md checks out CRLF on Windows. tools/command-center/validate.py:217 hashes the WORKING-TREE bytes (snapshot.read_bytes()), not the blob.
failures_triaged.residual_real_defect: REACH-6 is unrunnable on ANY Windows checkout with default autocrlf. CI stays green because Linux checks out LF. Severity: portability of the gate, not correctness of the data. Fix options: add `*.md eol=lf` to .gitattributes, or normalise CRLF before hashing in validate.py.
failures_triaged.verdict: REFUTED as a repo regression; CONFIRMED as a Windows-portability defect in the gate
